title: TikTok Shop Top Product Tracker — Data v5
description: Search TikTok Shop products, persist snapshots across runs, calculate sales velocity, 24h/7d sales, price history, review growth, creator growth, views, commission, stock changes, trend, and a confidence-adjusted top-product score.

searchActorId.title: Search provider Actor
searchActorId.description: Apify Actor used to search TikTok Shop products.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One or more TikTok Shop search terms, for example Beauty, Airfryer, Saugroboter, or Kosmetik.

tiktokCategories.title: TikTok categories
tiktokCategories.description: Optional broad categories that are converted into search queries.

region.title: Region
region.description: TikTok Shop market passed to the search provider.

maxItems.title: Max products per query
maxItems.description: Maximum products requested from the search provider for each keyword/category.

maxOutputProducts.title: Max products in output
maxOutputProducts.description: Maximum ranked products written to the final Dataset. All discovered products can still be tracked in history before this output limit is applied.

trackHistory.title: Track history
trackHistory.description: Persist product snapshots between runs so sold24h, sold7d, price history, trend, creator growth, review growth, views growth, and stock changes can be calculated.

historyStoreName.title: History Key-value store
historyStoreName.description: Named persistent Key-value store used for product history across Actor runs.

maxSnapshotsPerProduct.title: Max snapshots per product
maxSnapshotsPerProduct.description: Maximum historical snapshots retained for each product.

windowToleranceHours.title: Historical baseline tolerance (hours)
windowToleranceHours.description: Maximum time difference allowed when selecting the nearest historical snapshot for 24h, 7d, and 14d metrics. 18 hours works well for roughly daily runs.

priceMode.title: Price normalization
priceMode.description: auto keeps small integer prices as major currency units and divides large integer-like values by priceDivisor; raw never divides; minor_units always divides.

priceDivisor.title: Price divisor
priceDivisor.description: Divisor used for minor-unit prices. Use 100 for cents.

autoMinorUnitThreshold.title: Auto minor-unit threshold
autoMinorUnitThreshold.description: In auto price mode, integer-like raw prices at or above this value are divided by priceDivisor. Default 100 handles values such as 861 -> 8.61 while keeping 19 -> 19.00.

onlyDiscounted.title: Only discounted
onlyDiscounted.description: Keep only products with a positive discountPercent.

onlyInStock.title: Only in stock
onlyInStock.description: Keep only products whose provider explicitly exposes inStock=true or a positive stock quantity.

minDiscount.title: Minimum discount %
minDiscount.description: Minimum discountPercent required in final output.

minSold24h.title: Minimum sold in 24h
minSold24h.description: Minimum sold24h required. Leave at 0 until enough history has been collected.

minSold7d.title: Minimum sold in 7d
minSold7d.description: Minimum sold7d required. Leave at 0 until at least about 7 days of snapshots exist.

minCommissionPercent.title: Minimum commission %
minCommissionPercent.description: Minimum affiliate commission required when commissionPercent is provided by the source.

sortBy.title: Sort results by
sortBy.description: Metric used to rank the final output.

includeRawProviderData.title: Include raw provider data
includeRawProviderData.description: Include the complete original search-provider record in each Dataset row for debugging and discovery of additional fields.
